style_prefix: Bleak corporate science-fiction editorial illustration, restrained ink lines, matte gouache color, bruised amber and desaturated teal palette, tactile worn metal, humane faces, readable silhouettes, practical work grime, symbol-only interfaces.

prompts.prompt: Wide freight-habitat galley on a subtly curved floor: six bolted tables, forward soup counter, port maintenance door and hull-status panel, aft frosted counseling booth, starboard management vestibule and roster reader.
Maintenance delegate in orange coveralls serves mushroom broth while a gray-suited seal technician guards a grease-marked ledger and a cream-jacketed assessor arranges towels behind frosted glass.
Two tired workers write a C-12 pressure sequence and ticket number into a stained galley menu ledger beside a leaking blue cup and falsely green status panel.
Inside a two-chair counseling booth, an orange-suited worker holds a warm towel opposite a silver-braided assessor; both watch a locked black session-archive dock.
A seal technician fits an emergency filter patch over a whining galley return grille while a worker cuts one citrus gel into eight slivers for the exhausted dock crew.
A rota delegate authorizes six names on a green loading schedule while broth from a leaking cup runs down the seal technician's sleeve.
Ordinary breakfast fills the curved galley: patched coveralls, meal chits, soup bowls, a menu ledger, frosted care booth, green C-12 panel, and the last filter packet under the counter.
Amber C-12 alarm divides the galley as an immaculate navy-uniform manager and two gray security contractors enter from a separate vestibule carrying an incident form.
The orange-suited delegate stands between five levers: worker ledger, hot soup pot, six clearance badges, contractor archive slate, and management incident form.
Split wall screen shows an amber seal trace and a severe lunar underwriter while worker, assessor, and manager point to competing records around the galley.
Centered political still life: paper repair ledger, locked care archive, incident form, crew badges beneath a soup pot, filter packet, and a red-green convoy bond surrounding one worker delegate.
Hard-lit docking collar inspection reveals a heat-warped retaining ring while two workers hold their stained repair record under a remote underwriter's witness screen.
Two key tokens meet at a locked counseling archive while a bounded ninety-second waveform glows and a manager waits as a blurred silhouette beyond frosted glass.
Filter mesh, food canisters, and replacement valves arrive under green departure lights while a signed fatigue finding feeds a larger contractor renewal display.
Six exhausted workers eat cold broth under red roster light, copy a grease-marked ledger three times, and open one emergency filter packet beside six individual refusal tiles.
